 Appearance:

 No. 1  MR RR TRIVEDI, ADVOCATE for the Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) No. 1
[1] The appeal is taken up for Settlement in Lok Adalat.
[2] Mr. J.K. Shah, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal/settlement pursis, which is taken on record.
The withdrawal/settlement pursis is signed by the authorized signatory, which is presented in person in the Court, and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP.

[3] It is submitted that the offeence alleged against the accused persons under the Prevention of Food Adulteration HC-NIC Page 1 of 2 Created On Sat Sep 16 11:56:21 IST 2017 R/CR.A/762/2015 ORDER Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty/punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, it is State Of Gujarat vs Bharatbhai Govindbhai ... on 9 September, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116576081/
1 compoundable under Section 69 of the Act.
[4] In view of the withdrawal/settlement pursis, the present appeal stands disposed of.
[5] The Record and Proceedings (R & P) is ordered to be remitted to the Trial Court forthwith.
(A.G.URAIZEE, J) CHAIRPERSON M KUMAR HC-NIC Page 2 of 2 Created On Sat Sep 16 11:56:21 IST 2017 State Of Gujarat vs Bharatbhai Govindbhai ... on 9 September, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116576081/
